Our Process

Care at Every Stage.

Professional textile restoration is a sequence of careful decisions, not a single generic cleaning step.

01

Assess

Start with the condition. Restoration begins with understanding what happened and evaluating the affected textiles.

02

Sort

Different materials require different care. Items are organized so appropriate cleaning and handling methods can be selected.

03

Clean

Treat the textile, not simply the stain. Professional cleaning methods address the condition of the item while respecting its material.

04

Restore

Give recoverable items their best opportunity to return as close as reasonably possible to pre-loss condition.

05

Finish

Details matter. Cleaning is followed by careful finishing and preparation.

06

Return

Ready to go back where they belong. Restored clothing and textiles are prepared for return.
